DiscordServer.title: DiscordServer
DiscordServer.description: Represents a Discord server's configuration within the application.

serverName.description: The name of the Discord server.

adminRoles.description: Array of role names that are considered administrative for earning admin points.

PublicDiscordServerInfo.title: PublicDiscordServerInfo
PublicDiscordServerInfo.description: Represents the public, non-sensitive information for a Discord server, used for lists.

serverName.description: The name of the Discord server.

UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Represents a user's profile within a specific Discord server.

discordUserId.description: The user's unique ID from Discord.

avatarUrl.description: URL of the user's Discord avatar.

roles.description: A list of the user's role names from the Discord server.

dailyShoutout.description: The AI-generated Discord embed JSON for the user's daily shoutout.

shoutoutGeneratedAt.description: Timestamp of when the last daily shoutout was generated.

CalendarEvent.title: CalendarEvent
CalendarEvent.description: Represents an event in a server's calendar.

userId.description: The ID of the user who created the event.

userAvatar.description: The avatar URL of the user who created the event.

username.description: The username of the user who created the event.

LeaderboardEntry.title: LeaderboardEntry
LeaderboardEntry.description: Represents a user's entry on the leaderboard for a server.

LeaderboardSettings.title: LeaderboardSettings
LeaderboardSettings.description: Configuration for leaderboard point values for a specific server.

raidPoints.description: Points for participating in a raid on another community member.

followPoints.description: Points for following a community member's stream.

subPoints.description: Points for subscribing to a community member.

giftedSubPoints.description: Points for gifting a subscription in a community member's stream.

bitPoints.description: Points per 100 bits cheered for a community member.

chatActivityPoints.description: Points for being an active chatter in a community member's stream.

firstMessagePoints.description: Points for sending the first message of the day in the Discord server.

messageReactionPoints.description: Points for reacting to a message (e.g., an announcement).

adminEventPoints.description: Admin points for creating a calendar event.

adminLogPoints.description: Admin points for adding a Captain's Log.

adminMessagePoints.description: Admin points awarded for each message sent.

DiscordMessage.title: DiscordMessage
DiscordMessage.description: Represents a Discord message stored from a specific channel.

forwardedMessageId.description: The ID of the message created in the target channel after forwarding.

reply.description: A reply sent from the app to this message.

ForwardingRule.title: ForwardingRule
ForwardingRule.description: Represents a single rule for forwarding messages from a source channel to a target channel.

ActiveCalendar.title: ActiveCalendar
ActiveCalendar.description: Represents an active, posted calendar embed in a Discord channel.

/discords/{serverId}.description: Public-readable collection of servers for populating UI lists. Contains non-sensitive info.

/servers/{serverId}.description: Top-level collection for each onboarded Discord Server. Contains private config and subcollections.

/servers/{serverId}/users/{userId}.description: User profiles specific to a Discord server.

/servers/{serverId}/calendarEvents/{even.description: Calendar events for a specific Discord server.

/servers/{serverId}/leaderboard/{entryId.description: Leaderboard for a specific Discord server.

/servers/{serverId}/adminLeaderboard/{en.description: Admin-only leaderboard for a specific Discord server.

/servers/{serverId}/messages/{messageId}.description: Archived messages for a specific Discord server, used for forwarding.

/servers/{serverId}/config/forwardingRul.description: Configuration for message forwarding rules for a server.

/servers/{serverId}/config/activeCalenda.description: A collection that tracks all active calendar embeds posted in various channels.

/servers/{serverId}/config/leaderboardSe.description: Singleton document for storing leaderboard point configuration for a server.
